title: NORMAL REFERENCE SHEET
subtitle: What a steady patient looks like.

rows.label: EYES
rows.normal: Pupils tighten in light. Both eyes follow it.
rows.ordinary: Implants don't tighten. They still follow.

rows.label: HANDS
rows.normal: Lets go on 'release', inside one second.
rows.ordinary: Shakes, twitches and a weak grip.

rows.label: PORT
rows.normal: Calm skin at the socket. No dark threads.
rows.ordinary: Burnt pins, scars, cheap cable marks.

rows.label: SPEECH
rows.normal: Says 'I' and 'my'. Remembers what they did.
rows.ordinary: Nerves, rudeness, a skipping voice box.

rows.label: TEMPER
rows.normal: Pushed, face and voice react together.

threshold_note: The house rule printed in the footer: this many broken lines mean drifting. Every drifting case must break at least this many (case_db checks it), and the record counts the player's own crosses against it. The count is advice: nothing scores it or stops a decision.
footer: Two broken lines = drifting: call TRAUMA TEAM.
Strange is not sick. A refusal is not a sign.
